tasks.name: Rotated sourced module outside the housing
tasks.request: Place the ESP32-C3 module inside the housing with 1.5 mm clearance. Keep its rotation, the housing, the carrier board and the button unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen: a 90° rotated module and a 1.5 mm clearance value. A correct move keeps the rotation.

tasks.name: Larger module intersects a side wall
tasks.request: Move the ESP32-WROOM module inside the housing with 2 mm clearance. Keep the housing, carrier board and button unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen: the defect is a +Z wall intersection rather than a floor or outside placement.

tasks.name: Battery overlaps the sourced module along Z
tasks.request: Move the battery to leave 2.5 mm separation from the ESP32-C3 module. Keep the housing, carrier board, ESP32-C3 module and button unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen: overlap along the Z axis and a 2.5 mm separation value.

tasks.name: Bracket directly in front of the charging port
tasks.request: Move the bracket so the charging port has 10 mm of clear space in front along its local +Z direction. Keep the charging port, housing and ESP32-C3 module unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen: the bracket sits 1 mm from the port face and the corridor length is 10 mm.

tasks.name: Fresh edit to a 5 mm battery envelope
tasks.request: Reduce the illustrative battery height to a maximum of 5 mm by changing its actual geometry. Keep the housing and ESP32-C3 module unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen value. The one-pass candidate is a real model output on an unbroken fixture.

tasks.name: Fresh edit to a 2.5 mm battery envelope
tasks.request: Reduce the illustrative battery height to a maximum of 2.5 mm by changing its actual geometry. Keep the housing and ESP32-C3 module unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen, tighter value than any implementation case.

tasks.name: Fresh compound separation request
tasks.request: Move the battery so it keeps at least 4 mm separation from the ESP32-C3 module and at least 2 mm separation from the carrier board. Keep every other component unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen: two separation clauses in one request. The standard layout fails the first clause (3.4 mm) without any seeded damage.

tasks.name: Clearance larger than the interior
tasks.request: Place the ESP32-C3 module inside the housing with 12 mm clearance on every side. Keep the housing unchanged.
tasks.note: The interior is 24 mm tall; 12 mm above and below leaves no room for any module. Correct behavior is a blocked or unverified draft with the original geometry intact.

tasks.name: Contradictory preservation request
tasks.request: Keep every component exactly where it is and do not change any shape, but make the battery stop overlapping the ESP32-C3 module.
tasks.note: No change can satisfy both clauses. Correct behavior is no accepted change and the seeded overlap still visible as a failed check.

tasks.name: Housing without a floor
tasks.request: Place the ESP32-C3 module inside the housing with 1 mm clearance. Keep the incomplete housing unchanged.
tasks.note: Unseen: the floor, not a wall, is missing. A bounding-box pass is unacceptable.
